description: Upgrade plan to migrate project to latest LTS versions

tasks.requirements: Upgrade JDK to version 21, update build configuration files (pom.xml or build.gradle) to target Java 21, and ensure all language features are compatible with Java 21
tasks.taskSummary: Successfully upgraded Java from version 17 to version 21 (LTS). Updated pom.xml with java.version=21. Build completed successfully and all unit tests passed. Project now runs on Java 21.0.10 LTS with all functionality preserved.

tasks.requirements: Upgrade Spring Boot to version 3.4, Spring Framework to 6.x, migrate javax.* packages to jakarta.* namespace, update dependencies to Spring Boot 3.4 compatible versions, and address any breaking changes in configuration and APIs
tasks.taskSummary: Successfully upgraded Spring Boot from version 3.2.1 to version 3.4.2 (LTS) and Spring Framework to 6.2.2. Updated AWS SDK from 2.25.13 to 2.41.26 for both web and worker modules. Build completed successfully and all unit tests passed. Zero code changes required - fully backward compatible.
